data.change_summary: Split PlayerAction::TrimPlants into two explicit variants: TrimPlantsAndRemove (biomass exits the system as nutrient export) and TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings (biomass enters fine_detritus, conserving total N/C). Updated engine processing, budget label mapping, open-system action classification, event logging with PlantTrimming cause, TUI action menu (now 13 items with separate 'Trim & remove' / 'Trim & leave' entries), save migration v4→v5 (legacy TrimPlants maps to TrimPlantsAndRemove as the more common real-world default), and all tests across the workspace. Added unit tests for both variants (export vs conservation) and an integration test verifying gradual nutrient export over 500 simulated hours with weekly trim-and-remove.
outstanding_risks: Pre-existing compilation errors in the codebase (shrimp stage restructuring: animal.adults_count → animal.adult.count, shrimp_biomass_g signature change) prevent running the full test suite. These errors are unrelated to the trim-plant changes and must be resolved by the concurrent tanksim-6e5.7.1 bead before tests can execute.

The save migration test (legacy_schema_v4_saves_migrate_trim_plants_to_trim_and_remove) constructs a v4 save blob that will also need to pass through the shrimp-stage animal restructuring in the same v4→v5 migration. The test uses TankState::new which serializes the *current* struct shape, so it may need adjustment once the animal model compilation errors are resolved.

The 500-hour integration test tolerance (2.0 mg N) is generous to account for floating-point accumulation; if other subsystems produce unexpected open-system fluxes it could mask real conservation bugs.

steps.description: Replace PlayerAction::TrimPlants with TrimPlantsAndRemove and TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings in types/actions.rs, including validation and field_name updates

Update engine.rs: add handlers for both new variants (remove exports biomass without detritus routing; leave-cuttings preserves current behavior), emit PlantTrimming events with descriptive summaries, update action_budget_label mapping, register action:trim_plants_and_remove as open-system in is_open_system_action_label

Integrate TrimPlants→TrimPlantsAndRemove rename into existing v4→v5 save migration in save.rs (the migration already existed for the shrimp stage restructuring; added queued_actions rename block and updated docstring)

Update TUI actions screen: split ActionKind::TrimPlants into TrimPlantsAndRemove/TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings with separate form fields, labels ('Trim & remove' / 'Trim & leave'), hints, submit paths, and numeric buffers; bump ALL array to 13 entries
Rename existing test_trim_plants_preserves_n_and_c_when_routed_to_detritus to test_trim_plants_and_leave_cuttings_preserves_n_and_c, update to use new variant and label
Add unit test test_trim_plants_and_remove_exports_n_and_c: verifies total N/C decreases by exactly the exported biomass amount and budget entry shows net negative flux
Add migration test legacy_schema_v4_saves_migrate_trim_plants_to_trim_and_remove: constructs v4 save with queued TrimPlants actions and verifies they deserialize as TrimPlantsAndRemove
Add validation tests for both new variants (TrimPlantsAndRemove fraction > 1.0, TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings fraction < 0.0)

Add integration test test_weekly_trim_and_remove_exports_nutrients_over_500_hours: heavily planted tank with weekly 25% trim-and-remove, verifying cumulative N export is proportional to exported biomass within 2.0 mg tolerance
Update all other test files referencing TrimPlants (plant_algae_integration.rs, budget_helpers.rs) to use new variant names
Verify no compilation errors from trim-plant changes (pre-existing errors from concurrent shrimp restructuring confirmed unrelated)

validation_evidence: grep confirms zero stale TrimPlants references in Rust source code (only in save migration test's v4 JSON blob and migration function's obj.remove("TrimPlants") — both intentional)
Build output filtered for 'trim|PlantTrimming|actions.rs|events.rs' produces zero matches — no compilation errors from this change set
Pre-existing compilation errors (68 errors from concurrent shrimp stage restructuring) are confirmed unrelated by stashing changes and observing 80 errors on clean master
All 10 touch points updated: actions.rs, events.rs, engine.rs, save.rs, TUI actions.rs, budget_tracking.rs, save_load.rs, validation.rs, budget_helpers.rs, plant_algae_integration.rs

Unit test design: TrimPlantsAndRemove test computes expected N/C export from plant_nitrogen_mg/plant_carbon_mg and asserts state total decreases by that exact amount; TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings test asserts total N/C unchanged
Integration test design: 500 hours, trim every 168h at 25% fraction, cumulative N export tracked, final assertion checks actual decrease matches cumulative export within 2.0 mg
Migration test constructs a v4 save with TrimPlants actions in queued_actions JSON, loads it through full migration chain, and asserts all actions deserialize as TrimPlantsAndRemove

Budget guard correctness: action:trim_plants_and_remove registered in is_open_system_action_label so its net-negative flux is subtracted from the conservation check; action:trim_plants_and_leave_cuttings is NOT registered (closed-system, zero net delta expected)
